protocol.aggregation: equal valid-block AUC and pooled-event AUC per sequence; equal sequence weights per seed
protocol.causality: four block-local bidirectional arms; continuous causal EBF
protocol.repair: replace only released polarities outside {-1,+1} uniformly in {-1,+1}
protocol.target_mask: complete fixed-N10240 prefix of each first-3M stream
protocol.uncertainty: descriptive imputation sensitivity; seeds and sequences are not flattened or bootstrapped

summary.contrast_orientation: first arm AUC minus second arm AUC; positive favors first arm
summary.interpretation: descriptive imputation sensitivity, not sampling confidence intervals
summary.standard_deviation: sample SD over the ten fixed imputation seeds (ddof=1)
